Lakeside Custom Printing

Lakeside is home to a diverse and hardworking community. With a population of over 21,000 as of 2020, it has a rich history dating back to 1886 and continues to be a hub for skilled trades and entrepreneurship. Lakeside thrives on the expertise of skilled professionals in various trades.

Custom Printing for Lakeside's Workforce

At ImageOn, we understand the unique needs of our local tradespeople and small business owners. We offer a range of services to help you promote your business and build your brand:

  1. Custom T-Shirts: Stand out on the job site with high-quality, durable custom t-shirts featuring your company logo.

  2. Embroidery Services: Add a professional touch to your workwear with our precision embroidery services.

  3. Commercial Printing: From business cards to banners, we've got all your commercial printing needs covered.

Why Choose Lakeside Custom Printing?

  • Local Expertise: We understand Lakeside's unique character and the needs of the community.

  • Quality Materials: We use top-grade materials that can withstand the demands of your work environment.

  • Fast Turnaround: We know time is money. Count on us for quick, efficient service.

  • Competitive Pricing: Fair prices that respect your hard-earned money.

Supporting the Community

As long as there are Sycamores and Mighty Mountains we are proud to serve Lakeside's rich history and vibrant present. Just as Lakeside has evolved from its early days of the Lakeside Hotel and famous racetrack, we're here to help your business grow and succeed in the modern era.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the requirements for the design files or artwork to be engraved?

Most of our clients provide their own design.

An Adobe illustrator file with all elements/layers separate and fonts embedded/packaged is ideal.

An .svg file is also acceptable. A vector file, .eps, or a .jpeg that is high res (resolution) will also work.

Black and white files work best. Anything in white is not engraved. Anything in black (or another color) will be burned by the laser.

Do you offer engraving services, or can you engrave my product?

We offer laser engraving, marking, and cutting services. We can engrave or manufacture parts and products for you, or provided by you. Please contact us for any special requests.

What materials can be laser cut?

We are able to cut a variety of materials; some of the most common are paper, mylar, acrylic, wood, and fabric.

Do you have minimum order requirements?

You can order 1 to 1,000 or more of any of our products.
